availability.name: Brionna Jones
availability.short_comment: General manager Dan Padover said Friday that Jones (leg) won't return to game action before the FIBA World Cup break, Meghan L. Hall of USA Today reports.
availability.long_comment: Padover added that the team hopes to provide an update on Jones after the break. Madina Okot will likely continue to see a slight bump in minutes behind Angel Reese until Jones is cleared to play.

availability.name: Dorka Juhasz
availability.short_comment: Juhasz (not injury related) notched 10 points (4-11 FG, 1-4 3Pt, 1-4 FT), seven rebounds, three assists and one steal across 32 minutes in Hungary's 84-63 FIBA World Cup win over Japan on Tuesday.
availability.long_comment: Juhasz didn't deliver her most efficient performance, though she was still one of four players to score in double figures for Hungary. She also finished third on the team in rebounds and assists. The 26-year-old forward and Hungary will now look toward their quarterfinals matchup with Team USA on Thursday.

availability.name: Elena Buenavida
availability.short_comment: Buenavida (coach's decision) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dream.
availability.long_comment: Buenavida has yet to make her WNBA debut and will remain on the inactive list Sunday. Her next opportunity to play will come against the Liberty on Sept. 18.
availability.authority_note: ESPN injury feed. Status is ESPN’s; comment text often cites a named reporter. Not the league’s official injury report.

availability.name: Antonia Delaere
availability.short_comment: The Lynx temporarily suspended Delaere's contract Tuesday.
availability.long_comment: This is an expected move ahead of the World Cup. Delaere has just been an emergency depth piece for the Lynx this season.

availability.name: Skylar Diggins
availability.short_comment: Diggins (knee) will miss the remainder of the 2026 WNBA season, Sara Jane Gamelli of BallisLife.com reports.
availability.long_comment: She will now "focus on recovering an aggravated right knee injury." She hadn't played since July 3 and her rehab didn't progress as quickly as she would've hoped. She appeared in 19 games and posted averages of 14.2 points, 3.2 rebounds and 4.9 assists.
availability.authority_note: ESPN injury feed. Status is ESPN’s; comment text often cites a named reporter. Not the league’s official injury report.

availability.name: DiJonai Carrington
availability.short_comment: Carirngton (foot) is out for Saturday's game against the Liberty.
availability.long_comment: With the WNBA about to go on a hiatus for the World Cup, the Sky are taking a cautious approach with Carrington for Saturday. Her absence opens the door for Gabriela Jaquez to take on a bigger workload.
availability.authority_note: ESPN injury feed. Status is ESPN’s; comment text often cites a named reporter. Not the league’s official injury report.

availability.name: Rickea Jackson
availability.short_comment: The Sky announced Tuesday that Jackson will miss the remainder of the season after suffering a torn ACL in her left knee during Sunday's 86-79 win over the Lynx.
availability.long_comment: The season-ending knee injury is a devastating development for Jackson and the Sky, as the 25-year-old forward was well on her way to a career-best campaign. Through Chicago's first four games, Jackson averaged 18.0 points, 4.8 rebounds, 2.0 assists, 1.8 blocks and 1.5 three-pointers in 29.5 minutes per contest. After Jackson's early exit in Sunday's contest, Aicha Coulibaly opened the second half with the starters and looks to be the most likely candidate to move into the top unit for the Sky's next game Wednesday versus the Wings.
